perFinding: SITE 1 (behavioural) src/characters/paperdollPayload.js: key `tail` declared twice — `buildTail(ARGONIAN_HIDE,'argonian')` at :544 and `buildTail(ramps.skin,'argonian')` at :565. The later won, so the Argonian tail shipped shaded from the human sprite ramp.

SITE 1 C# reasoning: ramps.skin comes from BODY00I0.IMG, which RaceTemplate.cs:183 gives the BRETON doll. The Argonian body is BODY07I0.IMG (:336), the Khajiit's BODY06I0.IMG (:315). DFU swaps body image per race so none wears another's colour. SURVIVOR: ARGONIAN_HIDE; :565 copy deleted.

SITE 1 corroboration in-port: raceCharacter.js:49 bakes the tail with `bodyRamp = ARGONIAN_HIDES[tone].ramp` and takes only `{boot}` from sprite ramps. ARGONIAN_HIDE (bodyScales.js:13) is byte-identical to ARGONIAN_HIDES[0] ('Swamp', tone 0), so the survivor matches the in-engine bake exactly.

SITE 1b `tailCat` also duplicated (:545 and :565), both `buildTail(KHAJIIT_FUR,'khajiit')` — HARMLESS, identical values. Removed anyway as instructed. The asymmetry gave the bug away: at :565 the Khajiit tail used the race constant while only the Argonian one reached for ramps.skin.

SITE 1 blast-radius honesty: the viewer hides tails until the race is picked, then recolours from D.PALETTES (paperdollViewer.js:614-624), masking it there. Real in the data: D.tail.C carried Breton RGBs. Verified before/after — tail colours are now exactly the six ARGONIAN_HIDES[0] steps, previously HUMAN_SKINS[1].

SITE 1 also corrected a false comment above the survivor claiming the tails were 'packed nowhere, so D.tail/D.tailCat were undefined' — untrue, and that misreading is what caused the second copy. Replaced with the RaceTemplate.cs:183/315/336 citation, per the brief's comment idiom.
